children: U.S. trades software platform's fiscal Q2 revenue grew 21% yr/yr, beating analyst expectations
Company posted GAAP net loss but generated over $50 mln non-GAAP free cash flow
Growth driven by adoption of Agentic Operating System and AI investments
Q3 revenue outlook of $285 million-$287 million implies a sequential dip from Q2's $292.8 million
Company sees full-year 2027 revenue of $1.139 bln to $1.144 bln
ServiceTitan forecasts full-year 2027 non-GAAP income from operations of $152 mln to $154 mln
AGENTIC OPERATING SYSTEM - Co said revenue growth was driven by momentum in delivering its Agentic Operating System to the trades
AI INVESTMENTS - Co said investments in AI improved organizational velocity and contributed to results
MAX LOCATIONS EXPANSION - Co exceeded goal of doubling Max locations in Q2 and expects over 700 enrolled by year-end
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 15 "strong buy" or "buy", 2 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the software peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for ServiceTitan, Inc. is $110.00, about 25.1% above its September 4 closing price of $87.92
The stock recently traded at 58 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 52 three months ago
